fields.statement: QA cycle 1: built go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza to a scratch path (and the merge-base build for comparison). In a scratch Rhiza root/repo, a hold-workflow plan run with rhiza.autonomy.accept auto gated two change sets and journaled accepted for both on a plan branch; main got only their proposed log entries (change ls: proposed). rhiza inbox --json: base binary listed two accept items 'waiting for acceptance' (the bug); the built binary listed none. Dropping one accepted line from the run journal: the built binary listed exactly one accept item, for that change set, next rhiza accept --rule owner --change <id>, in --json and plain text. With rhiza.autonomy.accept owner (gated, no accepted entry): both accept items listed; after rhiza accept --rule owner on one, only the other remains. Scoped go test ./internal/api -run TestInbox and TestScripts/(inbox-owner-run-accept|stage-autonomy) both pass (ok).
